definitions.explanation: Any organism that is alive, including animals and plants.
Often refers specifically to animals or creatures.

notes:
{生|い}き{物|もの} refers to living organisms.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {生|い}き{物|もの}を{飼|か}う (to keep a creature)
- {生|い}き{物|もの}を{育|そだ}てる (to raise living things)

RELATED WORDS:
- {動物|どうぶつ}: animal
- {植物|しょくぶつ}: plant
- {生物|せいぶつ}: living organism (scientific term)
- {生|い}き{物|もの}: living thing (everyday term)
